issues.description: (Releases earlier than PAN-OS 8.1.24-h2) Due to a component change, versions earlier than PAN-OS 8.1.24-h2 are no longer supported on later hardware revisions of the PA-5200 Series.
Fixed an issue where logging in via the web interface or CLI did not work until an auto-commit was complete.
Fixed an issue where, after rebooting the firewall, authenticating using LDAP credentials did not work.
